company.shortDescription: Techmate Technologies is a software platform for on-demand technical support for small businesses.
company.description:
Techmate Technologies is a software platform for on-demand technical support for small businesses. The company is committed to supporting the distributed workforce and serving as an extension of companies with overstretched or geographically challenged IT departments. They equip companies with the tools to provide support across their entire organization regardless of location, addressing the way companies actually work today. 

Techmate Technologies matches users with the IT specialist, based on their location, availability, and the technical skills required for the job. The platform allows companies to book and manage onsite tech support across their entire organization. 

Founded in 2016, Techmate Technologies is headquartered in New York, United States.
